enum.name: FLYCORE_TEST_PHASE
enum.description: State of a Flycore-Q incoming inspection request.

entry.name: FLYCORE_TEST_PHASE_ACCEPTED
entry.description: The runner owns the test and is starting it.

entry.name: FLYCORE_TEST_PHASE_RUNNING
entry.description: The indicated hardware check is running.

entry.name: FLYCORE_TEST_PHASE_BUSY
entry.description: Another remote or local test is running.

message.name: FLYCORE_TEST_START
message.description: Request a full Flycore-Q incoming inspection. Send on the dedicated 8550 link.

message.name: FLYCORE_TEST_STATUS
message.description: Report acceptance, progress, or rejection of an inspection request.
message.field: Current result bit index, or 255 when no item applies.

message.name: FLYCORE_TEST_RESULT
message.description: Report the completed inspection to the requesting station.
message.field: Bit set when the corresponding hardware check ran. Bits 0 through 14 are assigned in the inspection order. Bit 15 is unused and always zero.
Bit set when the corresponding hardware check passed. Bits 0 through 14 are assigned in the inspection order. Bit 15 is unused and always zero.
One if all 15 inspection items passed, zero otherwise. The station evaluates UART3 separately upon receiving this report.
